sections.name: hasBlockedBranding, stripBlockedBranding
sections.title: Blocked name check and removal
sections.what: Provides two helpers: one tells whether text contains a blocked name, and the other removes every blocked name. Both ignore letter case.
sections.why: The header says Opportunity Map output must never carry consultancy branding.
sections.watch_out: Removal matches only the exact pattern, so a name split across a line break or spelled differently will get through.

summary: Checks text for blocked consultancy names and removes them from Opportunity Map output.
purpose: Keeps consultancy branding out of the Opportunity Map, so its output can be shared without it.
why: The header says Opportunity Map output must never carry consultancy branding, and that the blocked names are kept in the shared brand file so this filter stays shared code.
how: Takes the blocked-names pattern from the brand file. hasBlockedBranding checks whether any blocked name appears, ignoring letter case. stripBlockedBranding removes every match, also ignoring letter case.
outputs: A yes or no from hasBlockedBranding, and the text with blocked names removed from stripBlockedBranding.
risks: Removing a name can leave odd spacing or broken sentences. The filter only knows the names in the brand file, so a new name must be added there. A bad pattern in the brand file breaks this file too.
debug: If a name still appears, check that it is in the brand list and that its spelling matches. If output reads oddly after removal, check the spacing around the removed text.
